environment.audio: The default Windows output device through Sigma's own audio output; the device behind it was not identified.

verify_apple2_audio.scope: Independent per-cycle oracle and exhaustive bus checks for the Apple II speaker and Mockingboard model; no audio.

verify_apple2_audio_stream.scope: Owned stereo callback fixtures for the Apple II model: nonzero model output stays in memory, no native audio.

workloads_untimed.scope:
Apple II audio workloads. The default only verifies them; --measure needs the user's approval of the timing first.

Six workloads of 32768 stereo frames each. Every run, timed or not, compares the whole
PCM and the final state with the per-cycle oracle of verify-apple2-audio.py. With
--measure each workload runs in seven fresh processes, in rotated order, and the wall
time of the synthesis alone (not the set-up, the file write or the comparison) is kept.

S" examples/apple2-audio-play.fs" INCLUDED
: A2-ACCEPT-CARD ( -- ) 4 A2-CARD! A2-RESET 50176 A2-DEMO-INIT 50304 A2-DEMO-INIT ;
: A2-ACCEPT-LEFT ( -- ) A2-ACCEPT-CARD
  244 0 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 194 2 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 163 4 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG!
  56 7 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 11 8 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 10 9 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 10 10 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! ;
: A2-ACCEPT-RIGHT ( -- ) A2-ACCEPT-CARD
  208 0 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 3 1 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 20 6 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 46 7 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG!
  16 8 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 6 9 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 0 11 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 8 12 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG!
  14 13 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! ;
: A2-ACCEPT-BOTH { period -- } A2-ACCEPT-CARD
  period 0 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 62 7 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 12 8 50176 1 A2-DEMO-PSG!
  period 0 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 62 7 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! 12 8 50304 1 A2-DEMO-PSG! ;
: A2-ACCEPT-DONE { frames -- }
  PS-HANDLE @ IF -528 THROW THEN
  PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT @ IF -528 THROW THEN
  PS-FRAMES @ frames <> IF -24 THROW THEN
  ." handle=" PS-HANDLE @ . ." underruns=" PS-UNDERRUN-COUNT @ . ." frames=" PS-FRAMES @ . CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW ;
." SPEAKER: a 440 Hz tone on both sides, about 1 second" CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW
A2-SPEAKER-SETUP 96 FALSE A2-STREAM 49152 A2-ACCEPT-DONE
500 MS
." LEFT: a C major chord on the left only, about 2 seconds" CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW
A2-ACCEPT-LEFT 192 FALSE A2-STREAM 98304 A2-ACCEPT-DONE
500 MS
." RIGHT: a low note that swells and fades about twice, with a hiss, on the right only, about 2 seconds" CR STDOUT FLUSH-FILE THROW
A2-ACCEPT-RIGHT 192 FALSE A2-STREAM 98304 A2-ACCEPT-DONE
500 MS
." DEPTH=" DEPTH . CR 250 MS BYE
